Definition: probably from G2060; Hermas, a Christian:--Hermas.
BiblicalUsage: Hermas is a person named once in Scripture, in Romans. The full story lives on the Hermas profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Hermas in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
